artworks.title: La Rixe (The Brawl)
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (outer framing line): 31 x 23.5 cm (12 3/16 x 9 1/4 in.)
plate: 39.2 x 29 cm (15 7/16 x 11 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This painting depicts a dramatic scene in a town square with a group of onlookers. Several figures in the foreground are engaged in a tumultuous event, with some showing alarm or confrontation. One figure appears to be fainting or overwhelmed, supported by another. A person holding a sword in the center is the focal point. The scene is against a backdrop of ruins or historical buildings, creating a timeless atmosphere. The style is reminiscent of Thomas Rowlandson, known for lively, narrative-driven works that often satirize or dramatize daily life. The figures exhibit expressive gestures and emotions, in line with Rowlandson's animated style. The sky is depicted with large, billowy clouds adding depth and movement.

artworks.title: La Blanchisseuse
artworks.artist: Charles-Nicolas Cochin I after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic scene. It features a large tub, a child seated nearby, a woman washing clothes in a wooden tub, a child blowing bubbles, a figure holding up a sheet through a doorway in the background, a cat on the floor, and various household items scattered around.

artworks.title: La Fontaine
artworks.artist: Charles-Nicolas Cochin I after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic scene involving a water font in an interior setting. The illustration displays a large water vessel with a spout in the foreground, pouring water into a smaller container. Household items like buckets, ladles, a broom, and a basin are visible nearby. A tiled floor leads to a doorway showing another room with more activity. The drawing has a monochromatic tone with detailed shading and line work, capturing a rustic, historical ambiance focused on daily life chores.

artworks.title: La Bonne éducation (The Good Education)
artworks.artist: Jacques-Philippe Le Bas after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.description: The image shows two women in an indoor setting. One woman is standing on the left side, facing slightly right, wearing a long gown with a bonnet. The other woman is seated on the right, reading from an open book on her lap. She also wears a gown with a bonnet. The room features a cupboard with a bowl, a window letting in light, a chair, a covered table, and heavy curtains.

artworks.title: Le Chateau de carte (The House of Cards)
artworks.artist: Pierre Filloeul after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a young person at a table, building a house of cards. The individual is concentrated, wearing clothing from the 18th century. Various cards and a small box are on the table. The room is softly lit with a curtain on the right side.

artworks.title: Dame cachetant une lettre (Woman Sealing a Letter)
artworks.artist: Etienne Fessard after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: In the image, two individuals are depicted. One person stands facing the other person seated. The standing individual has long, dark hair and is wearing a detailed garment with buttons. The seated person has curly hair and is dressed in a flowing robe with intricate fabric folds. The seated person appears to be interacting with the standing person, who is offering them an object, possibly a piece of paper. A small dog with pointed ears is near the seated individual, looking upwards. The background includes a textured curtain, paneled walls, a table covered with a patterned cloth holding various items, and an ornate chair.

artworks.title: Le Dessinateur (The Draughtsman)
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques Flipart after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 30.3 x 21.8 cm (11 15/16 x 8 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist's studio with various objects. The drawing depicts a figure hunched over a large book or canvas on a table. To the left of the figure, there is a bust of a head placed on a box. On the wall in the background, a piece of artwork is displayed featuring a muscular, male figure. Above this, a painter's palette is hanging on the wall. There is a strong sense of detail and texture in the shading and lines, conveying the depth and texture of the materials and objects in the room. The image captures a moment of focus, creativity, and artistic study.

artworks.title: L'Ecureuse
artworks.artist: Charles-Nicolas Cochin I after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in front of a large barrel, cleaning its interior with a stick. The individual has a side profile with a subtle smile and wears a cap, long-sleeved blouse, apron, and long skirt. Surrounding the person are a smaller barrel, a large vat, a metal scoop, a flat pan, and a hook, with a textured wall in the background.

artworks.title: Le Garcon cabaretier
artworks.artist: Charles-Nicolas Cochin I after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile, standing in front of various containers in an 18th-century workroom or cellar. The person is dressed in period-specific attire and appears to be engaged in an activity involving a large tub. Surrounding them are wooden shelves holding additional containers and a sign with Roman numerals.

artworks.title: Etude du dessin (The Drawing Lesson)
artworks.artist: Jacques-Philippe Le Bas after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving and laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two men. One man is seated and sketching on a paper. He has distinct facial features with a prominent nose and tied-back hair. The other man is standing next to him, holding a rolled-up paper. The seated man wears a long coat and knee-length pants. The standing man wears a tricorn hat, a long coat, and knee-high socks. There is a sculpture of a seated male figure on a pedestal in the foreground. In the background, there is a plain wall with an oval frame. There is a small pot on a stand to the right.

artworks.title: Jeune fille au volant (Jeune fille a la raguette)
artworks.artist: Bernard Lépicié after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body view of a young person who is seated. They are turned slightly towards the right side. Their facial features include closed lips, a softly rounded nose, and they are looking outwards. The person has short, curly hair styled close to the head. They are dressed in old-fashioned attire with a tightly fitted bodice, low neckline, and puffed sleeves, reminiscent of an 18th-century style. The attire is detailed with folds, lace, and a ribbon tied around the shoulder. They hold a shuttlecock in their left hand and a racket in their right hand. The background is a plain textured surface.

artworks.title: Le Jeune Soldat
artworks.artist: Charles-Nicolas Cochin I after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.description: This print depicts a woman standing, facing the left, her head slightly turned over her shoulder toward us. She has a round, youthful face, pale skin, and wavy hair mostly covered by a white headscarf or cap. She wears a long, full-skirted dress with a fitted bodice and long sleeves. A drum is hung against her left hip, held with a strap across her shoulder. She holds a drumstick in her right hand, and a long pole connected to a small wheel or star-shaped object. The background is plain, beige paper, with some thin, cross-hatched lines.

artworks.title: Le neglige, ou la toilette du matin
artworks.artist: Jacques-Philippe Le Bas after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a woman and a child, standing in what appears to be an interior room setting. The woman is tending to the child's hair. The woman's body is shown from head to toe, and the child is seated on a chair with a cloak covering her shoulders. The child's hair is styled with a ribbon. The woman is dressed in layered garments, and the child is wearing a cloak. A small stool or table beside the child holds various items, and in the background, there is a cabinet or pedestal with a decorative object on top. The room is dimly lit.

artworks.title: La ratisseuse
artworks.artist: Bernard Lépicié after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.description: This print shows a seated woman in profile, facing the right. She has light skin, a straight nose, and small lips set in a faint smile. Her hair is tucked up into a white cap on her head, and she is dressed in a long-sleeved gown with a white apron. She is sitting on a wooden chair and appears to be peeling vegetables with a thin knife. She holds a root vegetable in her lap, and more vegetables and loose peels are scattered on the floor. A bowl on the ground in front of her is filled with pale chunks floating in water. Beside her on the left is a wooden chopping block with a cleaver on it, as well as a large pot and a pan with a long handle. The floor under her is light gray, while the wall behind her is dark gray. The background of the print is off-white paper, and there are some lines of text under the print.

artworks.title: Le festin royal
artworks.artist: Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grandiose ballroom or banquet hall. The image shows a large interior space with tall columns on the walls, decorated with garland and ornate chandeliers hanging from the ceiling. The ceiling has intricate carvings and decorative moldings, leading to a grand archway with curtains and chandeliers. The room is filled with elegantly dressed attendees as well as formal furniture like chairs and tables, creating a festive and social atmosphere.

artworks.title: Le bal masqué
artworks.artist: Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a print of a grand ballroom filled with elegantly dressed people. The room is filled with tall columns, large, arched windows with draped curtains, and elaborate chandeliers hanging from the ceiling. The lower third of the print is filled with people dressed in elaborate costumes, like long capes, ruffled dresses, and tall hats. Many of them appear to be dancing. A second space, visible through the large arched windows, is adorned with balconies and additional chandeliers. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark lines on beige paper.

artworks.title: Mme. XXX en Flore
artworks.artist: François Voyez after Jean-Marc Nattier
artworks.description: Printed with fine black lines and hatching on cream-colored paper, a smooth-skinned woman holding a flower garland is shown from the knees up in this vertical engraved portrait. She sits with her body facing us, and she tips her head to our left as she looks at us with large, wide-set eyes. She has dark, curving brows, a straight nose with a rounded tip, and her bow-shaped lips are closed in a slight smile. Her light-colored hair is swept back from her forehead and curls along her ears. The scoop neck of her dress is cut low and lined with a ruffle. Translucent cuffs peek out of voluminous, elbow-length sleeves, which are tied around the upper arms. A strand of pearls acts as a belt over a flaring skirt, which gathers in deep folds around the woman’s lap. The garland is made of roses, tulips, and other flowers. She holds up one end with her right hand, to our left. It drapes across her lap, and she holds the other end with her other hand. A gnarled tree grows up the right edge of the composition and more twist into the sky in the distance behind the woman. The portrait is engraved to look like it is framed, and the frame casts shadows along the inner edges and corners. Text below the frame reads, “MADAM DE EN FLORE. Se vend à Paris, chez Basan.” Smaller text under the left corner of the frame reads, “Nattier Pinxit” and text under the right corner reads, “Voyez le Jeune Sculp.”

artworks.title: Le duc de Chartres, son epouse et ses enfants
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin and Isidore-Stanislas Helman
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals in an interior setting. One woman sits on a bench holding a baby, while a small child stands on the bench next to her. A man stands beside the bench holding a hat and coat. A small dog is on the floor. The room is ornately decorated with a table, flowers, a painting on the wall, and a doorway.

artworks.title: Le chemin de la fortune
artworks.artist: Nicolas Joseph Voyez after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin

artworks.title: Le bouquet
artworks.artist: René Gaillard after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and two children in an ornately decorated room. The woman is seated in the center with delicate facial features and styled hair wearing an elaborate gown and flower headpiece. A person partially visible at the side holds the door open. A vase of flowers sits on a table beside the woman. One boy kneels before her offering a small bouquet, dressed in formal attire with buckled shoes. A girl stands nearby in a frilly dress matching the woman's attire. The background features a richly decorated wall with ornate paneling and drapery.

artworks.title: Le tric-trac
artworks.artist: Jacques-Philippe Le Bas after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: The image shows a group of four individuals gathered around a small table, three of whom are seated while one stands nearby. The framed portion features their upper bodies to lower legs, with the main focus on their activities at the table. The central seated woman is engaged in a board game, wearing an elaborate gown with prominently puffed sleeves and lace detailing. Seated across from her is a gentleman in a vested coat, while his hair is styled in a neat wave. Another seated individual leans in on the conversation, wearing similar period attire. The standing individual, dressed in an elaborate coat and hat, appears to be observing the game. In the background, the room is tastefully decorated with patterned walls and a large ornate framed painting depicting a figure in armor, along with draped curtains and a window introducing light.

artworks.title: La comete
artworks.artist: Jacques-Philippe Le Bas after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals in interior settings. The central figure is a man seated at a table, elegantly dressed. A woman stands beside him, engaged in conversation. Another woman sits at the table, and a man stands behind her. The room is richly detailed with ornate furniture, a small dog, a cat, wall sconces with candles, and a carved panel.

artworks.title: L'invocation a l'amour
artworks.artist: Carl Guttenberg after Etienne Theaulon
artworks.description: The image shows a person gazing at a sculpture on a pedestal. The person has long hair tied back and is reaching towards the sculpture. They wear a flowing gown. The background features lush vegetation, and there is another small figure near a vase or pot.

artworks.title: La Jeune Femme
artworks.artist: Philibert-Louis Debucourt
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures standing on a path in an outdoor setting. In the center is a young woman wearing a dress with floral decorations in her hair. To her left is an elderly man with white hair and a stern expression, wearing a tailcoat and holding a top hat. To her right is a younger man with dark hair and sideburns, elegantly dressed and also holding a top hat. In the background are trees, people in the distance, and a wooden fence.
